# OpenSCAD 3D Modeling

Honest caveats: OpenSCAD itself must be installed (free, open-source — `brew install openscad`); the skill insists on visual validation of every model before export, so expect a few preview-check rounds; you still need your own 3D printer or a printing service to turn the STL into an object. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
